svg.title: Figure 4.7: Cap-level prunes: supported totals and the unrecorded matrix
svg.desc: At the stop bbef1c8e…, every pair of one of the 83 height-4 units and one of the 600 caps, coloured by the cap-level prune that removed it: blocked, target not whole, or lattice inside
svg.text: Figure 4.7: Cap-level prunes: supported totals and the unrecorded matrix
State bbef1c8e… · 83 height-4 units × 600 caps = 49,800 pairs. These totals are exact; their cell assignments are not recorded.
Data note: The committed kernel ledger stores aggregate prune counts only, not unit identities or the prune for each
unit/cap pair. All matrix cells are therefore grey (unknown); colours appear only in the supported aggregate strip.
Committed research evidence · provisional colours · no Windows/DirectX or performance claim
